messages:
Maria G.: Quick heads-up — seeing elevated preemptible evictions in eu-west-1 starting ~08:10 UTC. a few jobs retried, some short-lived failures. anyone else seeing the same?
Jamal: yup, spot eviction rate jumped ~3x on our price-optimized pools. looks like auction cleared higher than our bid floor for several instance types.
Sophia: that's the classic price-optimized tail. capacity-optimized pools would trade cost for fewer interruptions. question: do we want to accept higher unit cost for lower SLO risk during this window?
Thomas: reminder that eu-west-1 is already our higher-latency tail for cross-region traffic. when we failover to other regions we see 40–80ms p95 addtl to inference SLOs. rolling capacity across regions hurts user-facing latencies.
deploy-bot: autoscaler: added 6 nodes to cluster-gpu-eu-west-1 at 08:12:14 UTC (policy: burst-preemptible, source: price-optimized).
Maria G.: I don't want more cross-region spill for production routes. proposal: temporarily switch the pool selector in eu-west-1 to capacity-optimized + keep a small bid premium to avoid immediate evictions. target window: 2 hours, then reassess.
Jamal: we should be explicit: set pool_preference: ["capacity-optimized","price-optimized"] and bump bid_multiplier to 1.2 for the affected instance families. also enable soft-drain grace of 60s to let jobs checkpoint.
Sophia: agreed. small config suggestion (will push if y'all ack):
```
spot_pools:
  eu-west-1:
    preference: [capacity-optimized, price-optimized]
    bid_multiplier: 1.20
    soft_drain_grace_s: 60
    warm_buffer: 2
```
Thomas: add a quick metric gate: if eviction_rate drops <1% within 30m we roll back to price-optimized. also watch p95 latency for inference routes closely.
Maria G.: +1. action items: Sophia will flip pool selector for eu-west-1, Jamal will run a 30m eviction simulation on staging with the new bid_multiplier, Thomas will add a temporary SLO dashboard panel. I'll notify on-call and the affected product owners.
Jamal: FYI I'll also run a tiny cost estimate script to show projected delta for 2 hours. if cost > 15% increase we abort and fallback to hybrid (reserve 10% on-demand buffer).
Sophia: pushing change now. logging the rollout in #eng-releases and adding a comment in the infra runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/spot-procurement (link).
Maria G.: thanks. please post the simulation and graph screenshots here once done. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: rollout: spot-selector-change applied to cluster-gpu-eu-west-1 by Sophia at 08:21:03 UTC.
Thomas: monitoring p95 and eviction_rate — will post updates if anything spikes.
Maria G.: wrap-up: target 10:30 UTC check-in. if stable we revert to price-optimized overnight.
Jamal: noted, will post cost numbers in thread.
Sophia: done with initial change, staging sim queued.
Maria G.: thanks team.
